# Declarations, Bindings & Modules

This chapter specifies value bindings, mutability rules, separate function signatures, `#type` declarations, and module/visibility directives.

## Value bindings and mutability

| Binding Form | Syntax | Scope & Mutability | Rules & Diagnostics |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Immutable binding** | `x = expr` | Local or module constant | Immutable after binding; reassigning `x = v` emits `E3033` |
| **Primed local rebinding** | `x' = expr`<br>`x'' = expr` | Local mutable / stepped SSA binding | Once primed (`x' = 0`), subsequent updates in the same scope may write `x' = v`, `x = v`, or `x'' = v` |
| **Mutable module global** | `::g = expr` | Module-wide mutable state | Readable as `g` or `::g`; writable inside functions as `g = v`, `::g = v`, or `g ::= v` (`E3033` if `g` was not declared with `::`) |
| **Forward type annotation** | `x: Type` (own line) | Local or module declaration | Declares the static type of `x` before assignment; allocates no zeroed storage (`E3045` if read before write; `E3130` on partial record init) |
| **Inline type + value** | `x: Type = expr` | **Forbidden** | Rejected with `E2009`; place `x: Type` on the line preceding `x = expr` |
| **Discard assignment** | `_ = expr` | **Forbidden** | Rejected with `E2044`; invoke side-effecting calls directly as statements |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

::counter = 0

bump: Int => Int
bump = delta =>
   counter = counter + delta
   acc' = counter
   acc' = acc' * 2
   acc'

io::out $ bump(5)   // 10
```

## Function signatures and definitions

Function types and parameter names are separated onto consecutive declarations:

| Form | Syntax | Semantics | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Multi-parameter signature** | `f: T1, T2 => R` | Declares positional parameter types and return type `R` | `E3084`: body type mismatch |
| **Nullary signature** | `f: () => R` | Declares a 0-argument function returning `R` | — |
| **Void return signature** | `f: T1 => ()` | Declares a side-effecting function returning `Unit` (`void`) | `E2104`: `()` used as value expr |
| **Compile-time parameter** | `f: #! T: Type, T => R`<br>`f: #! N: Int => R` | Declares compile-time `Type` or constant parameter specialized per call site | `E3129`: `Type` lowered at runtime |
| **Function definition** | `f = a, b => body` | Bare parameter names (never parenthesized `(a, b) =>`) followed by `=>` and expression or indented block | `E2040`: explicit `_` parameter |
| **Nullary definition** | `f = !=> body` | 0-argument function body; invoked with postfix `!` (`f!`) | — |
| **Unannotated function** | `f = a, b => a + b` | Inferred via static unification across body and call sites; **never defaults unknown types to `Int`** | `E3103` / `E3128`: ambiguous or underconstrained type |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

clamp_low: Int, Int => Int
clamp_low = val, floor =>
   val < floor | floor | val

banner: () => String
banner = !=> "ready"

io::out $ clamp_low(-3, 0)
io::out $ banner!
```

## Type declarations (`#type`)

`#type` registers a nominal or structural type in the current module scope:

| Type Category | Syntax | Representation & Semantics |
|---|---|---|
| **Scalar / type alias** | `#type UserId Int`<br>`#type Point2 Vec2` | Transparent alias for an existing primitive, composite, or nominal `#type` (shares the target's nominal identity) |
| **Named record** | `#type Point (x: Int, y: Int = 0)` | Nominally distinct C-ABI aligned product type (`E3084` on name mismatch against other `#type` records); unifies with matching anonymous records `(x = 1, y = 2)` and tuples `(1, 2)` |
| **Multiline record** | `#type Point`<br>`   x: Int`<br>`   y: Int` | Indented or parenthesized multiline field list; newline separates aligned fields |
| **Positional tuple** | `#type Pair (Int, String)` | Positional fields accessed via `.0`, `.1`, ... |
| **Homogeneous tuple / SIMD** | `#type Vec4 (Float * 4)` | Contiguous inline repetition of `N` elements; supports SIMD arithmetic and intrinsics |
| **Packed / aligned record** | `#type Hdr #packed #align 4 (...)` | `#packed` removes padding; `#align N` enforces power-of-two byte alignment `N` |
| **Bitfield record** | `#type Flags #packed u16 (syn: <>, ack: <>, res: 14)` | Packs 1-bit `<>` flags and integer bit widths into `u8`, `u16`, `u32`, or `u64` (`E2055` if sum exceeds backing width) |
| **Growable array** | `#type Ints Int{}` / `#type Buf u8{256}` | 24-byte `{ len, data, cap }` arena-backed dynamic array (optional default capacity `{cap}`) |
| **Slice** | `#type View Int[]` | 16-byte `{ len, data }` non-owning contiguous view |
| **Hash map** | `#type Dict String ^ Int` | Arena-backed open-addressed hash table (`Key` in `String`, `Int`, `Addr`) |
| **Ramification** | `#type Opt < Int | >`<br>`#type Res < Int | Error >` | Two-slot positional sum type (`RamPN`, `RamNP`, or `RamPP`) |
| **Nominal enum** | `#type Expr < Lit(Int), Add(Expr, Expr), Nop >` | 16-byte `{ i64 tag, ptr payload }` tagged union with $\ge 2$ uppercase variants (`E2070`, `E2012`, `E2074`) |
| **Type generator (`#!`)** | `Box: #! T: Type => (val: T)`<br>`#type IntBox Box(Int)` | Compile-time function returning a `Type`, instantiated via `#type` |

## Modules, visibility, and FFI directives

| Directive | Syntax | Scope & Semantics | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Standard / local import** | `#use io`<br>`#use "lexer"`<br>`#use net/http` | Resolves relative `.dva` files first, then `std/<name>.dva`. Binds module under its last path segment (`io::out`, `http::get`) | `E5001`: module not found<br>`E5002`: circular import |
| **Package import** | `#use @pkg`<br>`#use @pkg/sub` | Resolves external dependency declared in `edva.ccl` via `.edva/imports.ccl` | `E7001`–`E7021`: package errors |
| **Public visibility** | `#public` / `#pub`<br>`#public f: Int => Int` | Alone on a line: sets default visibility to public for subsequent declarations. Prefixing a declaration: exports that single symbol/type | `E3005`: private symbol access |
| **Private visibility** | `#private` / `#priv`<br>`#private helper = ...` | Alone on a line: resets default visibility to module-private. Prefixing a declaration: marks that single symbol private | — |
| **Foreign C import** | `#foreign "c" puts: Addr => i32`<br>`#foreign "m" cos: Float => Float` | Declares an external C ABI symbol from library `"c"`, `"m"`, or a library path; requires an explicit type signature | `E2060`: missing foreign signature |
| **C ABI export** | `#export add: Int, Int => Int` | Emits an unmangled C-callable symbol with platform C calling convention | — |
| **Compile-time size / align** | `#size Type`<br>`#align Type` | Evaluates to the target ABI byte size or byte alignment of `Type` as a compile-time `Int` | — |
